train_detector: train a detector model using mmdetection with XCiT backbone and configurable datasets
build_detector: build a detector model from config with train and test configuration parameters
build_dataset: build a dataset from configuration for training or validation in mmdetection pipeline
parse_args: parse command-line arguments for training including config path, work directory, gpus, and launcher
set_random_seed: set random seed and deterministic cudnn options for reproducible model training
